plain: Stubborn attachment to your own views and unfair treatment of people who differ.

webster.text: Obstinate or blind attachment to a particular creed, or to certain tenets; unreasonable zeal or warmth in favor of a party, sect or opinion; excessive prejudice.

more.text: The practice or tenet of a bigot.

example.quote: in short, my friends, among them is seen the action and counteraction of good sense and bigotry;
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, Second Inaugural Address, Mar. 4, 1805
